archetype_catalog.use_when: workflow, route, system, gate, or evidence flow needs first-glance structure
archetype_catalog.layout_description: A title and claim sit above an editable system map with route lanes, gate stack, evidence band, and connector lanes kept outside readable text.
prohibited: route labels without explanatory audience text

archetype_catalog.use_when: status proof, executive readout, or low-density route outcome summary
archetype_catalog.layout_description: Large status panels occupy the middle, supported by a separate proof or takeaway band and a visible hierarchy object.

archetype_catalog.use_when: sequence, milestone, causal evolution, or proof chronology
archetype_catalog.layout_description: A timeline rail with milestone nodes and off-rail labels, with evidence and takeaway zones separated from the sequence.
prohibited: more milestones than the selected zone capacity

archetype_catalog.use_when: risks, controls, gates, criteria, or comparative quality readout
archetype_catalog.layout_description: A matrix or comparison field with filled cells, clear row and column grammar, and a separate signal or takeaway area.
prohibited: four-card template for fewer than four facts
flat equal panels without comparison semantics

archetype_catalog.use_when: decision, recommendation, operating readout, or proof dashboard
archetype_catalog.layout_description: A decision or recommendation zone creates first-glance hierarchy, with proof objects and takeaway separated by zones.

archetype_catalog.use_when: native_visual_sample true with one-slide route status proof
archetype_catalog.layout_description: One title, one claim, one wide input hub, three status cards, three vertical connector drops, and one proof band.
prohibited: more or fewer than three status cards

archetype_catalog.use_when: native_visual_sample true with one-slide decision and proof split
archetype_catalog.layout_description: One title, one claim, left decision panel, right proof stack, visible rail, and bottom takeaway band.

modes.use_when: the audience must decide from a recommendation and its mutually exclusive support
the conclusion earns force through situation, tension, proof, and resolution
the audience must build understanding or capability step by step
presence, demonstration, or a small number of memorable proof objects leads
the audience needs complete, scannable information without a forced thesis

patterns.content_shape: values over ordered time
patterns.use_when: direction, cumulative volume, or multi-series movement is the message
patterns.skip_when: time order is absent or category ranking is primary

patterns.content_shape: named categories with comparable values
patterns.use_when: rank, magnitude, or side-by-side differences matter
patterns.skip_when: composition or continuous time is the message

patterns.content_shape: parts of one whole or nested composition
patterns.use_when: share, allocation, or hierarchy composition matters
patterns.skip_when: parts do not share a valid denominator

patterns.content_shape: observations, ranges, correlation, or outliers
patterns.use_when: spread, cluster, association, or distribution shape matters
patterns.skip_when: only aggregate category values are available

patterns.content_shape: actual, target, completion, or capability scores
patterns.use_when: goal attainment or multi-axis capability is the message
patterns.skip_when: there is no declared baseline or comparable scale

patterns.content_shape: additive and subtractive contributors between two totals
patterns.use_when: the audience must explain how a start becomes an end
patterns.skip_when: contributors do not form a running total

patterns.content_shape: flow with splits, merges, or volume loss
patterns.use_when: magnitude through a system or conversion stages is material
patterns.skip_when: steps have no quantity or branching semantics

patterns.content_shape: ordered steps, phases, or pipeline outputs
patterns.use_when: sequence and handoff logic matter more than time scale
patterns.skip_when: the relation is cyclical or durations need an axis

patterns.content_shape: milestones, durations, or roadmap states
patterns.use_when: time position, duration, or delivery order is the message
patterns.skip_when: steps are timeless or cyclical

patterns.content_shape: closed-loop stages or compounding feedback
patterns.use_when: the final stage returns to or strengthens the first
patterns.skip_when: the process is one-way

patterns.content_shape: layers, containment, maturity, or reporting hierarchy
patterns.use_when: levels and parent-child structure are the message
patterns.skip_when: items are peers without containment or rank

patterns.content_shape: one core with outward capabilities or inward forces
patterns.use_when: core-periphery relation and edge direction matter
patterns.skip_when: a strict hierarchy or sequence is required

patterns.content_shape: two axes, grid cells, or named quadrants
patterns.use_when: position, priority, intensity, or cross-classification matters
patterns.skip_when: there is only one comparison dimension

patterns.content_shape: options, pros and cons, tiers, or decision gates
patterns.use_when: the audience must compare alternatives and land a choice
patterns.skip_when: items are unrelated facts without decision criteria

patterns.content_shape: rectangular facts, metrics, statements, or schedules
patterns.use_when: precise row-column lookup is more honest than a chart
patterns.skip_when: the message is a visible quantitative shape

patterns.content_shape: many weighted topics, modules, or nested areas
patterns.use_when: coverage and relative emphasis matter more than sequence
patterns.skip_when: each item needs a detailed sentence or exact position

patterns.content_shape: effect with grouped causal branches
patterns.use_when: the audience must diagnose causes rather than follow a process
patterns.skip_when: causal evidence is unavailable or the relation is merely sequential

patterns.content_shape: systems, components, routes, or actors connected by typed relationships
patterns.use_when: the promise depends on topology, dependency, or information flow
patterns.skip_when: items are merely grouped or sequential without meaningful edges

patterns.content_shape: two or three sets whose overlap is the message
patterns.use_when: shared membership or intersection carries the claim
patterns.skip_when: sets do not overlap or need quantitative area accuracy

patterns.content_shape: parallel items, agenda, roster, principles, or hero evidence
patterns.use_when: the message is scannable parallel coverage or one dominant proof object
patterns.skip_when: sequence, hierarchy, or comparison must be encoded

profile_selection_policy.quality_debt_policy: A visually pleasing illustration that loses the lecture argument is a style failure.

profiles.use_when: operator proof, executive status, or route evidence board
profiles.layout_motif: warm canvas, strong action title, proof band, restrained connector rails
quiet evidence field, timeline rail, proof notes outside the rail

profiles.use_when: risk, gate, control, or tradeoff deck
profiles.layout_motif: decision-first hierarchy, matrix field, explicit gate rail

profiles.use_when: consulting, architecture, or type-led system explanation
profiles.layout_motif: strict grid, sharp rules, large whitespace, asymmetric proof anchors

profiles.use_when: market review, finance, research, or data-led long-form analysis
profiles.layout_motif: editorial columns, source lines, annotated charts, strong typographic hierarchy

profiles.use_when: engineering, architecture, or annotated technical walkthrough
profiles.layout_motif: schematic line work, explicit nodes, measured annotations, restrained depth

profiles.use_when: architecture, culture, product, or brand story led by inspectable imagery
profiles.layout_motif: large inspectable image fields, editorial captions, quiet text blocks, deliberate crop rhythm

profiles.use_when: 教学讲解、医学科普、研究汇报需要亲和且可连续讲述的手绘视觉

typography.title: 细钢笔手写标题，字面清楚，字距略松
typography.body: 短标签使用同一钢笔笔触；英文、数字和期刊名保持可辨识
typography.native_fallback: 选择已安装、笔画自然的手写/人文黑体；不要用僵硬正楷代替

material_and_mark_making: 近白纸面和轻微纸纹
细墨轮廓与自然起收笔
半透明水彩叠色
蓝绿、暖黄和少量红色强调
箭头与连接线保留手绘不规则感
profiles.composition: 先建立首眼对象、因果关系和结论区；构图可变，不固定三栏卡片；医学对象和数据承担解释职责
profiles.text_treatment: 页面可共同绘制文字，但关键数字、真实二维码、真实界面和论文图保留可核验原始资产；文字不能压在高频纹理上
profiles.prompt_recipe: fine pen hand lettering, thin ink outlines, translucent watercolor, warm paper, clear lecture diagram, readable scientific labels, varied composition
forbidden_patterns: 印刷楷体盖在水彩背景上
只画装饰图标不画语义关系
用纹理和贴纸代替结构
review_checks: 首眼是否是页面主张或证据
箭头/分组是否能在无讲稿时读出
中文、英文、数字、期刊名是否同属自然笔触
相邻页是否保持墨色、纸色、叠色和字形连续

profiles.use_when: 需要中国书写气质、克制留白和东方材料感的医学或战略讲课

typography.title: 有锋面的毛笔/钢笔混合字形，保持大字号可读
typography.body: 短句、数字和拉丁字母用较细干笔，避免粗重书法占满页面
typography.native_fallback: 使用可读的人文宋/楷体作为排版基线，再用墨色和笔触做风格化

material_and_mark_making: 宣纸或温白纸面
浓淡墨塑形、干笔边缘和淡彩薄染
蓝灰、茶赭、少量朱砂作为语义强调
留白作为层级和阅读路径
局部飞白与不均匀墨量
profiles.composition: 用留白和一到两个解释性主体建立呼吸；山、水、竹、印章只有在承担内容语义时出现；关系图、证据行和结论区仍要清楚
profiles.text_treatment: 字形、墨量和留白共同构成风格；不把纸纹当作水墨，不让装饰性国风元素抢走医学证据
profiles.prompt_recipe: Chinese ink wash on warm xuan paper, controlled ink modeling, dry-brush edges, restrained blue-gray and ochre wash, vermilion emphasis, generous negative space, clear lecture diagram
forbidden_patterns: 硬加山水、竹子或印章作为边角装饰
普通扁平2D插画叠加水墨滤镜
高饱和渐变和玻璃卡片
书法字无法读出科学数字
整页只剩氛围没有讲课结构
review_checks: 留白是否服务阅读而非制造空洞
墨色层次是否区分标题、关系、证据和结论
国风来自笔墨/纸面/空间而非随机装饰
医学解剖和数据仍然准确清楚

profiles.use_when: 需要有辨识度的叙事插画，同时保持投影场景下的讲课结构和证据可读性
profiles.approval_scope: project_or_owner_selected; current project accepted as a three-page reference sample, not a global default

typography.title: 细钢笔手写，略有自然粗细变化但不潦草
typography.body: 标签和数字贴近对象，英文/数字清楚，避免印刷楷体
typography.native_fallback: image-first优先；若原生排版，使用细人文无衬线并以绘画式标注补足气质

material_and_mark_making: 分层纸张和轻微纸边
块状但不僵硬的蓝绿/暖赭色面
局部透明水彩与不规则轮廓
明确方向的柔和投影
局部透视和可触摸的书册、工具、人物器物
墨线与色块共同解释对象
profiles.composition: 先画教学对象和关系：一页一个首眼主对象，标签贴对象、箭头贴关系；使用局部场景支持解释，不用满幅房间、窗景或风景占位
profiles.text_treatment: 文字和解释图共同设计；标题、证据、结论保持三级层次；避免把文字后加到“有空的插画”上
profiles.prompt_recipe: editorial illustration with layered paper, irregular contours, local perspective, blue-green and warm ochre planes, translucent watercolor, directional soft shadows, fine pen lettering, one clear explanatory hero object, complete lecture slide
forbidden_patterns: 先画满幅办公室再找空处塞字
带文字的独立插画而不是讲课页
普通扁平2D卡片加少量山竹装饰
文字漂浮、箭头断裂、结论压在复杂前景
随机山水/竹子/窗景填边角
review_checks: 第一眼是否落在主张、证据或关系对象
页面是否像可讲授的PPT而非插画海报
每个标签是否指向唯一对象
色彩、字形、纸感和投影是否跨页连续
旧版相对审阅是否更清楚而非只是更漂亮

profiles.use_when: 文化史、战略转折、人物/地域叙事或需要强轮廓与平面构成的讲课

typography.title: 清晰的木刻感标题，轮廓明确
typography.body: 短标签和数据使用规整高对比字形，不模拟难读的古文字
typography.native_fallback: 保留平面色块、边框线和非对称构图，文字使用稳定的衬线/无衬线组合

material_and_mark_making: 米白和纸纤维底
木版刻线和可见套色边缘
靛蓝、赭黄、朱红、黛绿的有限色盘
大块平面色与清楚轮廓
细微套色错位作为手工感
纹样只有在说明对象/类别/地域时使用
profiles.composition: 非对称裁切、前后层次和明确框取；以一到两个主图形承载论点，证据和箭头使用木刻线条，不套统一卡片
profiles.text_treatment: 文字必须稳定、可读、少而精；日式假名、随机汉字和装饰性标题不可代替信息
profiles.prompt_recipe: Japanese ukiyo-e woodblock print inspired lecture slide, warm rice paper, indigo and vermilion limited palette, bold carved contours, flat planes, subtle registration shift, asymmetric framing, clear evidence diagram, readable labels
forbidden_patterns: 随机日文、假印章或无意义浪纹
用浮世绘纹样掩盖数据和关系
金属渐变、玻璃卡片、霓虹光效
古风装饰多于讲课信息
review_checks: 有限色盘是否形成层级而非单调
木刻线和套色是否帮助区分对象
非对称构图是否仍有清楚阅读路径
文化元素是否承担语义，未变成贴图
医学和科学文本是否可投影阅读

profiles.use_when: 讲者选择明亮温暖、干净轮廓和清楚色面的手绘动画气质，同时需要完整教学结构与医学证据可读性
profiles.approval_scope: project_or_owner_selected; art calibration does not imply whole-deck readiness; not a global default

typography.title: 清楚轻盈的自然细笔手写；字形服务投影阅读
typography.body: 标签、英文、数字和期刊行保持同一视觉家族与精确拼写
typography.native_fallback: 本profile使用整页图；不能据画风选项推定原生可编辑

material_and_mark_making: 明亮柔暖日光与可信局部空间
干净自然的深色手绘轮廓与清晰色面
奶油色受光面、青绿色阴影和少量暖赭色
温和简洁的人物与有生活感的解释性器物
局部保留绘画笔触，干净与克制不作为缺点
profiles.composition: 按页面主张安排首眼、对象关系、证据和结论；画法可借鉴手绘动画场景，教学页不必复制房屋街景，不把满幅插画当成通用课件背景
profiles.text_treatment: 文字与解释图共同设计；标题、图旁标签、数据与结论保持层级和可读性，科学符号与来源逐字检查
profiles.prompt_recipe: warm hand-drawn animation illustration, clean natural contours, clear painted color planes, cream sunlight and teal-green shadows, gentle simplified characters, credible local perspective, light legible pen lettering, complete lecture diagram with explicit relationships

generation_guidance.prompt_structure: a concise coherent visual description, then page-specific teaching relationships and exact copy
generation_guidance.calibration_boundary: art-only probes test visual language; representative complete lecture pages test style transfer and evidence fidelity

forbidden_patterns: 先画满幅场景再找空处塞字
带文字的独立插画而不是讲课页
用无语义树叶、窗景、山竹填空
把干净线条自动判为缺少风格而强加粗粝纹理
为满足字面风格词而改变医学对象、数据或页职责
review_checks: 无讲稿时是否能读出主张、关系和结论
明亮温暖的画法是否落在解释性主体上
文字、缩写、数值、解剖与来源是否准确
跨页字形、色彩和对象塑形是否连续
独立生成比较是否排除对应页成品输入，首次出图缺陷是否如实报告
人物、医学图、资料和工具是否使用同一画法；必须保留的真实资产是否清楚区分
混合医学页面是否被写实器官或照片质感压过教学主关系；反馈长句是否可顺读

object_treatment.characters: 同一套简洁手绘动画人物：清楚轮廓、概括五官和成块明暗；不在局部换成写实肖像、水彩照片或不同年龄/性别的替代角色
object_treatment.medical_diagrams: 保留正确解剖、模态和朝向，用同一套干净轮廓与简洁色面解释；真实影像若确有必要，独立标为经核验资产，不能生成假影像当证据
object_treatment.dossiers_and_tools: 资料、电脑和书册以同一局部透视与受光关系画成解释性器物；细节指向任务步骤、工具或质控，不用无意义屏幕图和杂物填充
object_treatment.relationships_and_copy: 箭头优先体现单向因果/反馈，标签就近放在安静水平文字区，长反馈句用自然换行，不因拥挤改成难读竖排
object_treatment.mixed_page: 多对象/多模态页面须逐类绑定同一视觉语言；全局一句风格词不能证明各子对象已遵守
